verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no user-definable rule or trigger-action system. "Start an application at login" is a single fixed autostart behavior, an adjacent feature rather than general event-triggered rules. The AT-SPI DBus interfaces are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
